scope: on-demand synthetic non-reentrancy diagnostic on the existing serialized worker
binding: The runner verifies fresh signed device identity before and after the run and checks role, source, hardware and unchanged boot. Request ID identifies the run.
cancellation: Disconnect requests cancellation without reusing worker memory until synchronous work returns. Partial results never pass.
security: Synthetic public message and callback only; no key is used by the diagnostic. Separate identity proofs use the established permanent identity signing interface.
qualification: This is not full pairing, concurrent execution, radio contention, entropy, or C9 lifecycle acceptance.
